title: Grove Getaway | Scenic 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Grove Getaway is a Seagrove Beach condo with lake views, a screened balcony, community pool, and bikes just minutes from the beach and 30A dining.
description_expanded: Grove Getaway Coastal Comfort Two Minutes to the Beach Home Introduction Escape to Grove Getaway , a beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bath condo in Seagrove Beach offering the perfect blend of coastal living and modern convenience. Just a 2-minute bike ride from the pristine Beachwood Villas and Santa Clara Beach Access, this one-level retreat features serene lake views, a screened balcony, and access to a peaceful community pool. Home Highlights Beach Proximity - 2-minute bike ride to Beachwood Villas Public Beach Access Flexible Stays - Available year-round One-Level Living - Elevator and stair access to 2nd-floor condo 4 Taxi Bikes - the preferred vehicle for exploring 30A Outdoor Living - Screened-in balcony with cushioned seating, ceiling fans, and dining for 4 Lake View - Enjoy peaceful water views from the balcony Beach Gear - Complimentary use of a beach wagon, small cooler, and towels Community Pool - Overlooking large pond with grill, dining, and lounge seating Secure Access - Keyless entry for added safety Prime Location - 2-minute bike ride to Café 30A and Angelina's Pizzeria Full Kitchen - Equipped with drip and Keurig coffee makers Dining Options - Table seating for 4 plus breakfast bar for 2 Entertainment - Flat-screen TVs, cable, and Wi-Fi Laundry - Stacked washer/dryer in-unit Parking - Available for 2 vehicles, first-come, first-served Location Perks 2-min bike ride to Beachwood Villas Public Beach Access 2-min ride to Santa Clara Regional Beach Access (with beach service) 2-min bike ride to Café 30A and Angelina's Pizzeria Close to 30A dining, shopping, and entertainment Know Before You Go A mid-stay clean is required for reservations 10+ days (included in rate) Additional cleans available for an added fee Concierge services available, including grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, and additional bike rentals Parking is first come, first served (2 spaces) Community management does not allow pets
rooms_guidance: King Suite | TV, closet, dresser, ensuite bath with walk-in shower and soaking tub
Queen Guest Room | TV, closet, dresser, hallway access to full bath with combo shower/tub
Full Guest Room | Hallway access to full bath with combo shower/tub
